choose.when: SELECT activity_type, activity_time, activity_id, post_id, comment_id FROM ( SELECT 'POST' activity_type, created_time activity_time, id activity_id, id post_id, NULL comment_id FROM hit_post WHERE post_user_id=#{userId} AND post_status=1 AND is_deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'REPOST', a.created_time, a.id, a.post_id, NULL FROM hit_action a JOIN hit_post p ON p.id=a.post_id AND p.post_status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE a.action_user_id=#{userId} AND a.action_type=3 AND a.is_deleted=0 ) x ORDER BY activity_time DESC, activity_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'COMMENT' activity_type, c.created_time activity_time, c.id activity_id, c.post_id, c.id comment_id FROM hit_comment c JOIN hit_post p ON p.id=c.post_id AND p.post_status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE c.comment_user_id=#{userId} AND c.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY c.created_time DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT activity_type, activity_time, activity_id, post_id, comment_id FROM ( SELECT 'LIKED_POST' activity_type, a.created_time activity_time, a.id activity_id, a.post_id, NULL comment_id FROM hit_action a JOIN hit_post p ON p.id=a.post_id AND p.post_status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE a.action_user_id=#{userId} AND a.action_type=1 AND a.is_deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'LIKED_COMMENT', l.created_time, l.id, c.post_id, c.id FROM hit_comment_like l JOIN hit_comment c ON c.id=l.comment_id AND c.is_deleted=0 JOIN hit_post p ON p.id=c.post_id AND p.post_status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE l.action_user_id=#{userId} AND l.is_deleted=0 ) x ORDER BY activity_time DESC, activity_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'FAVORITE' activity_type, a.created_time activity_time, a.id activity_id, a.post_id, NULL comment_id FROM hit_action a JOIN hit_post p ON p.id=a.post_id AND p.post_status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE a.action_user_id=#{userId} AND a.action_type=2 AND a.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY a.created_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
